images.name: img49
images.prompt: Photorealistic split-screen vertical fashion editorial image, divided exactly in half by a clean straight vertical seam at the center. The top 28 percent of the whole image is empty plain background on both halves, nothing in it. LEFT HALF: a flat lay product photograph viewed from directly above on a light ivory plaster background, no person, items only in the lower 72 percent, neatly arranged top to bottom with small gaps: a light cream cotton baseball cap, a thick textured beige wool single-breasted blazer, an ivory knit sweater with a shirt collar (polo collar knit), wide-leg light-wash blue jeans with a full straight leg, a slim silver wristwatch, and a pair of beige suede slip-on loafers with fluffy cream shearling fur trim around the opening. RIGHT HALF: a headless body-only full-body street style photo of a slim young Korean man in his 20s wearing exactly the same items (the beige blazer open over the ivory collared knit, light-wash wide jeans, beige shearling-trimmed slip-on loafers, silver watch, holding the cream cap in one hand), walking calmly on a quiet Seongsu-dong brick-lined side street, only in the lower 72 percent, the frame is cut at the collarbone so there is NO head, NO chin, NO mouth, NO hair visible at all. Identical items in both halves, realistic fabric textures, soft overcast late-autumn daylight, 35mm film look. No text, no letters, no signs, no logos, no brand marks.
